source_documents.title: Contribution of radiative rate constants to crystallization-induced emission enhancement in boron-fused azobenzene complexes

reference_evidence_units.quote: moderate isolated yields (34% for BAz-F and 38% for BAz-Cl)
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Room-temperature crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA; 77 K crystal versus vitrified 10^-5 M 2MeTHF and Tol/2MP (1:9).
reference_evidence_units.statement: BAz-F is the fluorinated derivative explicitly synthesized and named in Scheme 1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This number is isolated synthetic yield, not fluorescence yield.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Comparison of (c) absolute FL quantum yield, (d) radiative rate constant, and (e) nonradiative rate constant between 1 wt% PMMA ﬁlms and crystals
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Room-temperature crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA; 77 K crystal versus vitrified 10^-5 M 2MeTHF and Tol/2MP (1:9).
reference_evidence_units.statement: Figure 2 gives BAz-F PMMA/crystal yields 0.6%/17%, kr 0.08/1.1 x10^8 s^-1 and knr 13/5.4 x10^8 s^-1 at room temperature.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Figure visually inspected. Main p2 summarizes PMMA yields as 0.8-2.3%, inconsistent with the plotted 0.6% for BAz-F; plot-specific value retained and flagged.

reference_evidence_units.quote: restriction of structural relaxation in the excited state
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Room-temperature crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA; 77 K crystal versus vitrified 10^-5 M 2MeTHF and Tol/2MP (1:9).
reference_evidence_units.statement: Crystal intermolecular contacts are proposed to reduce excited-state structural relaxation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Series-level interpretation; no direct vibrational-motion measurement for BAz-F.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the kr value of the crystalline sample of BAz-F was 1.7-fold larger than that in the solution
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Room-temperature crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA; 77 K crystal versus vitrified 10^-5 M 2MeTHF and Tol/2MP (1:9).
reference_evidence_units.statement: At 77 K, BAz-F crystal kr is about 1.7-fold above 2MeTHF glass; the source describes little accompanying knr change.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Relative to 2MeTHF, not all possible matrices; rates come from fitted lifetime/yield data.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Comparison of (b) absolute FL quantum yield, (c) radiative rate constant, and (d) nonradiative rate constant
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Room-temperature crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA; 77 K crystal versus vitrified 10^-5 M 2MeTHF and Tol/2MP (1:9).
reference_evidence_units.statement: Figure 3 labels BAz-F yields 46%, 54%, 57%, kr 0.83, 0.87, 1.4 and knr 1.0, 0.74, 1.1 x10^8 s^-1 for 2MeTHF, Tol/2MP and crystal at 77 K.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Figure visually inspected; crystal knr is not zero, and constancy is approximate.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the enhance- ment of kr was observed because of the weakest calculated coupling strength
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Room-temperature crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA; 77 K crystal versus vitrified 10^-5 M 2MeTHF and Tol/2MP (1:9).
reference_evidence_units.statement: Despite H-like intermolecular organization, BAz-F's small calculated splitting (0.05 eV) permits radiative enhancement; strong local contact does not necessarily mean strong exciton coupling.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Calculation reported in main; underlying SI dimer data not inspected. This is not J-aggregate enhancement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 2.09 for BAz-H, 2.03 for BAz-F, 2.19 for BAz-Cl
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Room-temperature crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA; 77 K crystal versus vitrified 10^-5 M 2MeTHF and Tol/2MP (1:9).
reference_evidence_units.statement: Calculated crystal refractive index is 2.03; the common Tol/2MP glass estimate is 1.53.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the refractive index dominantly contributes to the increase in kr.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Room-temperature crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA; 77 K crystal versus vitrified 10^-5 M 2MeTHF and Tol/2MP (1:9).
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source's normalization analysis favors n^2/polarizability as the main cause of halogenated-crystal radiative acceleration.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Dimer oscillator-strength approximation and calculated transition-energy error limit quantitative agreement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the slight decrease in kr,SB in a crystal was theoretically predicted due to the eﬀect of H-aggregation, especially in BAz-H and BAz-F
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Room-temperature crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA; 77 K crystal versus vitrified 10^-5 M 2MeTHF and Tol/2MP (1:9).
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source retains a smaller opposing H-aggregation/oscillator-strength contribution even for BAz-F.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: An opposing secondary contribution, not the cause of observed enhancement; dimer approximation only.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source explicitly invokes restriction of structural relaxation as an ambient contribution; the 77 K increase is not explained solely by RIM.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The crystalline environment both restricts relaxation at ambient temperature and changes local polarizability.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: A weak H-aggregation contribution opposing kr is explicitly calculated; retain it as subordinate to polarizability, not as an enhancing J mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The low-temperature controls isolate radiative acceleration attributed mainly to crystal refractive index.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Source explicitly invokes restriction of structural relaxation as an ambient contribution; the 77 K increase is not explained solely by RIM.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The crystalline environment both restricts relaxation at ambient temperature and changes local polarizability.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest binding, pore uptake or host inclusion mechanism is established; a solvent or self-assembly is not automatically host-guest chemistry.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific CT or TICT mechanism is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific excited-state proton-transfer pathway is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on is established; energy transfer and CT character are not by themselves PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: A weak H-aggregation contribution opposing kr is explicitly calculated; retain it as subordinate to polarizability, not as an enhancing J mechanism.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The low-temperature controls isolate radiative acceleration attributed mainly to crystal refractive index.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The extra heavy-atom ISC explanation is specific to Cl/Br, not assigned to F from series membership.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection mechanism is established; rotation restriction alone does not prove CI access.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-singlet-state emission or anti-Kasha mechanism is established; higher-state absorption alone is insufficient.
